description.value: Your own presence registers as valuable salvage to Scrap Sense — allies with that ability treat you as a walking parts bin, gaining a bonus to their own Crafting checks while you're nearby.

cinderfall.incomplete: This affects another creature's own roll, HP, or condition from the card holder's passive/item, which has no rule-element hook in real pf2e. (allies gain a Crafting bonus from your own passive presence).
